name: adb-plugin-invite-tracker
description: Track who invited whom. Invite leaderboard, join/leave logging, fake join detection, and milestone roles.
author: DeadIndian

process.persistentReason: Runs un-isolated (system:raw-client) to diff guild.invites.fetch() on member join (the only way to attribute an invite), maintain an invite cache on ready/inviteCreate/inviteDelete, and grant milestone roles — the invite-manager API and role mutation are outside the sandboxed RPC surface.

trackLeaves.description: Deduct invite credit when an invited member leaves
